_comment: Used by test_time_window.TestSamplingDelay. Asserts that no CPU sampling rows reach the cached output when ROCPROFSYS_SAMPLING_DELAY exceeds the workload runtime — proves the sampling subsystem honors the sampling_only-scope time_window from the SAMPLING_DELAY env var.

validation_queries.description: No timer_sampling rows should reach the cached output during a SAMPLING_DELAY window that exceeds the workload runtime
validation_queries.error_message: CPU sampling rows leaked into the cached trace despite SAMPLING_DELAY
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM regions WHERE category = 'timer_sampling'
